svg.text: Same 5 mH inductor + 20 Ω, 10 V square wave: what changes with frequency?
Steady-state current. Solid blue = with the inductor; dashed grey = resistor only.
current swings only between 0.060 A and 0.440 A
current swings only between 0.225 A and 0.275 A
current swings only between 0.2475 A and 0.2525 A
The faster the switching, the less time the current has to change, so it settles near the average (0.25 A).
